title: La carrosse aux deux lézards verts
summary: "La carrosse aux deux lézards verts" by René Boylesve is a novel published in 1920. This modern fairy tale follows twin sisters Gillette and Gillonne, who are raised by two mysterious governesses with opposing philosophies—one optimistic, one pessimistic. When the sisters disappear on extraordinary travels, their parents face accusations of sorcery.
